labelChirho: to be poured out, to flow
descriptionChirho: Nifal/Hofal passive: liquid or tears flowing or being poured out, used of water, blood, or weeping.
Nifal passive with extended sense of being spread or stretched out, distinct from the flowing of liquids.

labelChirho: to pour out, cause to flow
descriptionChirho: Hifil causative: actively pouring out or causing liquid to flow down, used of God or a person pouring out substances.
Hifil causative with figurative extension: to thrust down, give over, or deliver persons into the power of another, as in toppling enemies.
